comprehension: The round ('Round two') reads, and the name tags, type cards and subtitle make it plain that someone is judging three or four candidates. Who is winning does not read at a glance. You have to read each plate icon by icon and know that heart is good, drop is meh and cloud is bad, and nothing teaches that. In 04b (the real feed), Tilly and Quill show the same heart and drop and Frost shows heart and cloud, so all three plates look about the same and there is no leader. The empty fourth podium with no plate is unexplained. 'Your pick' reads clearly but small. The over-head marks read as emotions in the close-ups (heart charmed, drop unsure), but the gloom cloud reads as weather. Nothing in these stills says viewers are betting, and nothing ties the viewer's pick to odds or a stake.
biggestGap: Standing is coded by icons when it needs to be coded by light. Take Me Out lets you count who is ahead from across the room because a lit podium is about 216 luma and an off one about 58 in the accent colour (takemeout-02). Our three plates have the same dark pill, similar mid-value chips and about 34 px coins at 960. Make each heart a lit lamp (flat milk or mint at 200+ luma, coins about 1.5x larger) and every non-heart an unlit dark socket in the suitor's accent at about 25% brightness. Build the slots into the podium face in perspective instead of floating a pill in front of it, so the leader's podium is visibly the brightest thing on stage right in the 960 wide.
protect: The over-head emote construction (thin milk keyline, ink line, two-tone fill, one highlight) on the heart and the sweat drop. It is close to the Animal Crossing '!' and '?' sticker language and reads cleanly against the dark night set.

The pop timing shown in 07-pop-strip: a squashed seed, a stretched overshoot, then a settle into a tilted rest with a delayed flutter heart. It has real anticipation and follow-through. Only the peak size and the flutter's overlap need fixing.

Each suitor's standing is attached to that suitor's own podium, with hearts sorted first, and the viewer's pick is a quiet milk 'Your pick' tab in sentence case rather than a glow or a stamp. Keep that restraint and placement logic.
